title: Fitts sees HUD's unauditable books on library carts
place_text: Department of Housing and Urban Development, Washington

tellings.quote: "You know the old library carts with all the books on them?" She said, "They wheeled in one after another filled stacked with papers like organized, disorganized."

plain: Richard Dolan, a writer on Jesse Michels' podcast, relays a story from Catherine Austin Fitts, a former official at HUD, the US Department of Housing and Urban Development, from around the late 1980s and early 1990s. According to Fitts, when she asked for the department's books, staff wheeled in old library carts one after another, stacked with papers in no real order, so the accounts could not be audited. Dolan tells it to suggest that large sums of government money could not be traced.
